title: Roadmap Dependency Sentinel and Sequencing Policy
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Introduce a lightweight ‘Dependency Sentinel’ service and accompanying sequencing policy to reduce late-stage roadmap collisions across Eng/Design/Security/Infra. The sentinel should provide automated detection of blocking overlaps, sequence visualization, and targeted notifications to owners when a dependency threatens an initiative milestone. This ticket scopes the PM work: success criteria, stakeholder alignment, UX requirements for Console alerts, escalation flows, and a rollout plan paired with a small pilot team.
proposed_solution: 1) Define a dependency metadata schema (owner, type, SLA, earliest/critical windows, risk score). 2) Implement a central sentinel pipeline that ingests Linear issues, Design Figma links, Security review flags, and infra rollout calendars. 3) Add Console alert surfaces (per-initiative timeline view + toast alerts for owners) and an opt-in weekly summary email. 4) Pilot with two initiatives for one cycle, iterate based on false-positive rate and noise metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency metadata schema documented and accepted by Eng/Design/Security/Infra
Sentinel ingests Linear and marks >=90% of pilot dependencies with owner and window
Console initiative timeline shows dependency swimlanes and highlights conflicts
Notifications delivered to owners with <5 minute delay from detection
Pilot demonstrates >30% reduction in last-week-of-cycle blocked tasks for pilot initiatives
tradeoffs: Risk of notification fatigue vs. missing critical collisions — mitigated by initial opt-in and adjustable urgency thresholds
Building a full canonical source of truth vs. lightweight ingestion from existing tools — we start lightweight to deliver value fast
Automated blocking enforcement could be heavy-handed; initial release will be advisory only

notes: This is intentionally scoped as an advisory first-release to avoid heavy-handed enforcement. Long-term vision includes automated sequencing recommendations and optional enforcement hooks for Dedicated/Private rollout planning. We will evaluate adding RBAC to control who can override sentinel recommendations based on pilot feedback.
